mapper.sql: id, alert_type, severity, status, subject_type, subject_id, dedup_key, summary, evidence_json, detected_signal_at, first_detected_at, last_detected_at, occurrence_count, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at, acknowledgement_reason, version
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crawl_run WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSING', 'PAUSED', 'CANCELLING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crawl_failure WHERE resolved = FALSE AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_event WHERE status = 'OPEN'
SELECT id AS source_id, consecutive_failures, last_failure_at FROM data_source WHERE consecutive_failures >= #{threshold} AND last_failure_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

WITH ranked_run AS ( SELECT r.task_id, r.id AS run_id, r.read_count, r.parsed_count, r.finished_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.task_id ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC, r.id DESC) AS run_rank FROM crawl_run r WHERE r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND r.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ) SELECT task_id, run_id, read_count, parsed_count, CAST(parsed_count / read_count AS DECIMAL(10, 6)) AS success_rate, finished_at FROM ranked_run WHERE run_rank = 1 AND read_count >= #{minimumRecords} AND parsed_count / read_count < #{successRateThreshold} ORDER BY task_id
SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM graph_outbox_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'DEAD')
SELECT FROM alert_event WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey} AND status = 'OPEN'
SELECT FROM alert_event WHERE id = #{alertId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_event ( alert_type, severity, status, subject_type, subject_id, dedup_key, summary, evidence_json, detected_signal_at, first_detected_at, last_detected_at, occurrence_count, version ) VALUES ( #{alertType}, #{severity}, 'OPEN', #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{dedupKey}, #{summary}, CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSON), #{detectedSignalAt}, #{firstDetectedAt}, #{lastDetectedAt}, 1, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_event SET severity = #{severity}, summary = #{summary}, evidence_json = CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSON), detected_signal_at = #{detectedSignalAt}, last_detected_at = #{detectedAt}, occurrence_count = occurrence_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{alertId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE alert_event SET status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_by = #{actorId}, acknowledged_at = #{acknowledgedAt}, acknowledgement_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{alertId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
